test_scenarios.description: Batter scores 32 runs off 24 balls with 12 dot balls and 3 wickets down. High dot-ball pressure leading to rash shots.
expected_coach_insights: Identifies 50% dot ball ratio as the primary vulnerability
Recommends rotating strike with defensive or leg-glance singles
Flags over-reliance on lofted shots against tight bowling

test_scenarios.description: Batter scores 58 runs off 20 balls with 0 wickets lost, 6 sixes and 4 fours.
expected_coach_insights: Recommends maintaining composure against yorker lengths

test_scenarios.description: Batter heavily favors leg-side shots (14 out of 18 shots), struggling on off-side channel deliveries.
expected_coach_insights: Advises practicing cover drive and off-side cut drills
Suggests adjusting guard or back-foot trigger movement
